relevance_note: Single-patient report with individual detail: "A 4‐year‐old female patient of Puerto Rican and African American descent" who was "compound heterozygous (Comp Het) for 2 rare variants in LPIN2".
method_note: Hand-built JSON via a short Python script in scratch; every value came from reading the paper and every span was checked verbatim by script. No supplementary text is included in the Markdown (Supplementary Tables 1-2 and Supplementary Results are cited but absent), so the 23 previously published patients summarized in Supplementary Table 1 and the variants listed in the Discussion get no rows (no individual-level facts in the text). Healthy, NOMID and DIRA controls are out of scope (no LPIN2 variant); no total cohort size is stated, so cohort_size_as_stated is null. Parents are in scope as tested relatives: father carries the missense variant (also cDNA splice analysis), mother carries the deletion (aCGH of maternal DNA) and not the missense variant; no phenotype is reported for either parent. Contradiction/ambiguity: p.R517H (c.1550G>A) is called both a 'missense' variant/mutation and a 'splice site mutation' that alternatively splices out exon 10 or exons 10 and 11; recorded variant_type 'splice' from the sentences naming the splice effect. It was 'initially thought to be homozygous' before the deletion was found; final zygosity compound heterozygous. Deletion size is printed as 17.8‐kb and as 17,770‐bp; the original string uses the precise 17,770‐bp breakpoint description; no genome build is stated for the Chr18 coordinates (hg19 is mentioned only for RNA-Seq mapping), so none was attached. Transcript NM_014646.2 is printed only for cDNA primer design, not as the reference for c.1550G>A, so transcript_as_stated is 'not reported'. Age: the patient was 4 years old at NIH evaluation/first NIH visit and had a knee radiograph at 26 months for recurrent knee pain; onset age, diagnosis age and age at report are not stated (treatment has continued 6.5 years), so these are 'not reported'. Vital status not stated explicitly. Checklist: 'sterile osteomyelitis' is recorded as a feature but the CRMO checklist item is left not reported (chronic/recurrent multifocal course not stated); 'recurrent right knee pain' was mapped to joint pain (not bone pain); microcytic anemia marked observed from 'mild anemia' with MCV 65.2 fl below the stated normal range, although the word 'microcytic' is not used. Elevated IL‐1β and other cytokines were measured only in cultured monocytes/macrophages in vitro, not in serum, so 'elevated proinflammatory cytokines' is not reported. severity_or_detail values are short summaries; their span is the feature span.
